description: Wait until the runs one run_tests or run_suite call started have finished (judged, problems sorted), up to the given minutes, and return them. Finished runs say whether the test passed and how many major and minor problems each found. Once all have finished, comparison holds each test against its previous run (fixed, regressed, still failing, new) and the major and minor problems before and now, as compare_batch returns it. Call it again if it returns before they finish.

batch.description: The batch_id run_tests or run_suite returned.

name: wait_for_runs
